info.title: DemandAI Enterprise Demand Forecasting & Supply Chain API
info.description:
## DemandAI Enterprise API Services

DemandAI is an enterprise-grade retail demand forecasting and inventory optimization platform. It combines **Recursive Ensemble Machine Learning**, **TreeSHAP Explainable AI**, **Two-Way Price Decision Simulation**, and a **Conversational Agent** to deliver actionable supply chain intelligence.

---

### Core Architectural Capabilities

1. **14-Day Recursive Ensemble Forecasting (`/forecast`)**:
   - Multi-model weighted ensemble: **CatBoost (36%) + LightGBM (34%) + XGBoost (30%)**.
   - Recursive day-by-day inference across a 14-day future horizon.
   - Dynamic inventory health classification: `In Stock`, `Monitor`, `Reorder`, `Critical (Stockout Risk)`, and `Deadstock`.

2. **Two-Way Price Decision & Elasticity Engine (`/forecast/simulate`)**:
   - **Clearance Markdown (-1% to -90%)**: Simulates demand lift, inventory depletion days (DOS), and deadstock clearance feasibility.
   - **Markup & Revenue Optimization (+1% to +150%)**: Computes Price Elasticity of Demand (PED = %ΔQ / %ΔP), 14-day revenue impact ($P \times Q$), and demand throttling (DOS expansion) for stockout mitigation.
   - **Multi-Warehouse Network Rebalancing**: Auto-detects products across distribution hubs and recommends inter-warehouse stock transfers.

3. **Executive Reporting & PO Replenishment (`/forecast/export`)**:
   - **Multi-page Executive PDF Reports**: Clean 2-page executive layouts with vector charts (Category Donut chart, Top SKU bar charts, and paginated inventory data tables).
   - **PO Replenishment Orders CSV**: ERP-ready purchase order recommendations incorporating lead time and safety stock buffers.

4. **Conversational AI Agent (`/chat`)**:
   - LangChain ReAct SKU specialist powered by `gpt-6-luna`.
   - 9 specialized operational skills with strict tabular presentation directives (Prompt Rule 13).
   - Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming for real-time token delivery and tool call telemetry.

5. **Authoritative Inventory Wiki (`/wiki`)**:
   - Single Source of Truth for supply chain formulas (ROP, DOS, Safety Stock).
   - Bidirectional backend-to-frontend synchronization ensuring zero configuration drift.

post.summary: Run What-If Demand & Two-Way Price Simulation
post.description: Executes 14-day ML ensemble re-inference under two-way price changes (discounts: -1% to -90%, or price increases: +1% to +150%). Calculates 14-day revenue impact (P x Q), Price Elasticity of Demand (PED), Days of Supply (DOS), and deadstock clearance feasibility. Automatically performs multi-warehouse network rebalancing and inter-warehouse stock transfer triage.

tags.name: forecast
tags.description: **Demand Forecasting & Simulation Engine**: 14-day recursive multi-model ensemble (CatBoost, LightGBM, XGBoost), TreeSHAP value driver explainability, Two-Way Price Decision & Elasticity Engine (discounts & price hikes), executive multi-page PDF report generation, and PO replenishment CSV exports.

tags.name: chat
tags.description: **DemandAI Conversational Assistant**: Enterprise-grade multi-turn agent with 9 specialist analytical skills, dynamic intent guard filters, real-time RAG grounding over inventory telemetry, and Server-Sent Events (SSE) token streaming.

tags.name: wiki
tags.description: **Authoritative Inventory Wiki**: Centralized calculation formulas, business rules, and status threshold criteria for ROP, Days of Supply (DOS), Safety Stock, Deadstock triage, and on-demand frontend synchronization.

tags.name: pipeline
tags.description: **ETL & Execution Pipeline**: Real-time streaming pipeline callbacks for data ingestion, cleaning, validation, and model preparation with Server-Sent Events (SSE).

tags.name: feature-engineering
tags.description: **Time-Series Feature Store**: Rolling momentum indicators, calendar seasonality lags, discount interaction signals, and feature dataset export services.

tags.name: health
tags.description: **Infrastructure & Connectivity**: PostgreSQL RDS encrypted connection verification, TLS cipher audits, and database readiness probes.

tags.name: system
